sources.title: W2V Models (Self-Supervised Learning) | facebookresearch/omnilingual ...
sources.snippet: This document covers the W2V (wav2vec2) model family, which provides self-supervised learning (SSL) models for extracting acoustic features from raw audio. These models are trained to learn speech representations without transcription labels, making them useful for feature extraction tasks.
